# has occupancy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasOccupancy`](gmeow-hasOccupancy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasOccupancy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links a location to an occupancy measurement describing the current number of entities located at it. Flat form for the common case; promote to full reified [`Occupancy`](../classes/gmeow-Occupancy.md) when vantage, confidence, temporal scope, or standpoint matter.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the flat inverse link from a location to an occupancy measurement.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when vantage, confidence, or standpoint matter — read the reified [`Occupancy`](../classes/gmeow-Occupancy.md).

### How to use

- Use [`gmeow:hasOccupancy`](gmeow-hasOccupancy.md) for the common case; the measurement carries the count, unit, and time scope.
